content.en: A **Financial Market** acts as an intermediary that facilitates the transfer of funds from savers (surplus units) to borrowers (deficit units). It performs the critical function of **Capital Allocation**, ensuring that resources flow to the most productive sectors of the economy. Key functions include **Price Discovery**, providing **Liquidity** to assets, and reducing **Transaction Costs**.
